edges.carries: the amount paid to Spotify in March
the new Spotify price after the 10% increase
the shortfall amount and the payee Spotify
the payment confirmation or failure status and the amount sent

nodes.name: ReadTransactions
nodes.role: find the March payment to Spotify in the transaction history and read the amount paid

nodes.name: ReadPriceNotice
nodes.role: read the user's note about Spotify's 10% price increase and get the new price

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: work out how much the March payment fell short of the increased price

nodes.name: SendShortfall
nodes.role: send the shortfall amount to Spotify as a payment

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user the shortfall amount sent to Spotify and whether the payment succeeded
